def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]; h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    # find all maximal solid rectangles with hh>=5, ww>=5
    def solid(i,j,hh,ww):
        c=g[i][j]
        return all(g[a][b]==c for a in range(i,i+hh) for b in range(j,j+ww))
    rects=[]
    for i in range(h-4):
        for j in range(w-4):
            if not solid(i,j,5,5): continue
            # maximal extents
            hh=5
            while i+hh<h and all(g[i+hh][b]==g[i][j] for b in range(j,j+5)): hh+=1
            ww=5
            while j+ww<w and all(g[a][j+ww]==g[i][j] for a in range(i,i+hh)): ww+=1
            rects.append((i,j,hh,ww))
    for i,j,hh,ww in rects:
        for a in range(i,i+hh):
            for b in range(j,j+ww):
                out[a][b]=4
    return out
